edges.reason: msg.sender determines the teamMinters privilege branch and is the mint recipient in wlMint.
msg.sender determines the teamMinters privileged branch in batchMint.
_wlMint flag gates execution of wlMint.
_publicMint flag gates execution of batchMint.
basePrice is multiplied by count / divides msg.value in wlMint payment math.
basePrice is multiplied by count in batchMint payment math.
merkleRoot is the owner-controlled trust anchor for the allowlist check in wlMint.
teamMinters mapping grants an unchecked free-mint path inside wlMint.
teamMinters mapping grants an unchecked free-mint path inside batchMint.
_wlSupply cap is compared against the counter in wlMint.
_totalSupply cap is compared against the counter in batchMint.
_tokenIdCounter supplies and advances token ids in wlMint.
_tokenIdCounter supplies and advances token ids in batchMint.
initialize advances _tokenIdCounter while pre-minting team tokens.
currentToken reads the current value of _tokenIdCounter.
wlMint calls _safeMint, which invokes an external receiver callback before state is finalised.
batchMint calls _safeMint, which invokes an external receiver callback.
initialize loops calling _safeMint during initialization.
_safeMint triggers the ERC721 transfer hook path (onERC721Received and _beforeTokenTransfer) re-entering contract state.
withdrawAll forwards the entire balance with an unchecked send to the owner.
pause state affects the whenNotPaused modifier guarding _beforeTokenTransfer.
_baseURI output feeds tokenURI metadata construction.
proxyRegistryAddress is queried inside isApprovedForAll.
